notes.note: Reviewed the unified trigger policy against ComposerRunControl, ComposerChoice, StartComposer, StartApprovalSummary and ApprovalModeChip. Warning glyphs indicate full access or refused/pending approval; conversation changes use a neutral dot and changed-for-this-conversation accessible text. Known ACP command-derived approval engine identities supply the reply mark; unknown identities omit it. This is bounded source review; screenshot, provider and physical-device evidence are separate.
